import numpy as np
def _flank_min(build, kin, s_c, s_notch):
    fam = build(16, 10, 2, 1.0e-3, 2.015e-3)
    s = np.where(fam['notch'], s_notch, 0.0)
    M = kin(fam, s, s_c)['M']
    flank = (fam['ijk'][:, 1] == 4) | (fam['ijk'][:, 1] == 5)
    return float(np.min(np.linalg.eigvalsh(M[flank])[:, 0]))
assert np.allclose(_flank_min(build_families, kinematic_operators, 0.95, 1.0), target)

import numpy as np
def _bond_norm(build, kin, grad, A, curv, i0, j0, k0, di, dj, dk):
    fam = build(16, 10, 2, 1.0e-3, 2.015e-3)
    X = fam['X']
    u = X @ A.T + curv*np.stack([X[:, 1]**2, X[:, 0]**2, np.zeros(len(X))], axis=1)
    ops = kin(fam, np.zeros(len(fam['pk'])), 0.95)
    F = grad(fam, ops, u)
    ijk = fam['ijk']
    a = int(np.flatnonzero((ijk[:, 0] == i0) & (ijk[:, 1] == j0) & (ijk[:, 2] == k0))[0])
    b = int(np.flatnonzero((ijk[:, 0] == i0+di) & (ijk[:, 1] == j0+dj) & (ijk[:, 2] == k0+dk))[0])
    m = ((fam['pk'] == a) & (fam['pn'] == b)) | ((fam['pk'] == b) & (fam['pn'] == a))
    return float(np.linalg.norm(F[m][0], 'fro'))
A = np.array([[2.0e-3, 1.0e-3, 0.0], [-5.0e-4, 3.0e-3, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, -1.0e-3]])
assert np.allclose(_bond_norm(build_families, kinematic_operators, bond_deformation_gradients, A, 20.0, 8, 5, 0, 1, 1, 1), target)

import numpy as np
def _force_y(build, pf, force, c0, nx, ny, nz, eps, i0, j0, k0):
    fam = build(nx, ny, nz, 1.0e-3, 2.015e-3)
    u = np.zeros((len(fam['X']), 3))
    u[:, 1] = eps*fam['X'][:, 1]
    calY = np.where(fam['notch'], 1.0e30, 0.0)
    s = pf(calY, 120.0, 2.015e-3, c0)
    out = force(fam, u, calY, s, 3.2e10, 0.25, 120.0, 0.95, c0)
    ijk = fam['ijk']
    a = int(np.flatnonzero((ijk[:, 0] == i0) & (ijk[:, 1] == j0) & (ijk[:, 2] == k0))[0])
    return float(out['B'][a, 1])
assert np.allclose(_force_y(build_families, bond_phase_field, internal_force_evaluation, pfpd_normalization_constant('cubic'), 16, 10, 2, 1.0e-3, 8, 4, 0), target)

import numpy as np
def _grown(build, pf, force, c0, eps):
    fam = build(16, 10, 2, 1.0e-3, 2.015e-3)
    u = np.zeros((len(fam['X']), 3))
    u[:, 1] = eps*fam['X'][:, 1]
    calY = np.where(fam['notch'], 1.0e30, 0.0)
    s = pf(calY, 120.0, 2.015e-3, c0)
    out = force(fam, u, calY, s, 3.2e10, 0.25, 120.0, 0.95, c0)
    return float(np.sum(out['s'][~fam['notch']]))
assert np.allclose(_grown(build_families, bond_phase_field, internal_force_evaluation, pfpd_normalization_constant('cubic'), 1.0e-3), target)
